banner.title: reloader
banner.tagline: Restarts a workload when a ConfigMap or Secret it reads changes, so new values reach running pods without a manual rollout.

explainer.title: Watch the inputs, roll the consumer

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: Reloader watches every ConfigMap and Secret in the cluster through the API server, not through a polling loop.
steps.scene: an eye over a row of document cards

steps.title: Match
steps.text: A workload opts in with a reloader.stakater.com annotation, so only the pods that asked for a restart get one.
steps.scene: a tag clipped onto one of several stacked blocks

steps.title: Change
steps.text: When the referenced data changes, Reloader updates the pod template. The Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet then rolls.
steps.scene: a glowing ring turning around a pod template

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: The rollout follows the workload's own strategy and PodDisruptionBudget, one pod at a time, so the restart does not drop the service.
steps.scene: pods replaced one by one on a conveyor
